nodes.name: escape through service stair

nodes.name: Rosa secures the garden gate
nodes.description: Rosa locks the garden gate behind them and keeps the key instead of returning it to its hook.
evidence: Rosa locked the garden gate behind them with the key she had carried for thirty years and did not put back on the hook.

nodes.name: reach Lucia's parked car
nodes.description: The women reach Lucia's unlit car parked two houses away without being called back from the house.
evidence: Lucia's car was at the curb two houses down, unlit, and they reached it without anyone calling from the front steps

nodes.name: Asha recognizes the next step
nodes.description: As she gets into the car, Asha realizes the documents must be hidden somewhere Daniel cannot reach and made admissible before the morning meeting.
evidence: she understood that getting the pages out of the house was only the first half of the night: by morning the documents had to exist somewhere Daniel could not reach them and somewhere a court would credit

nodes.name: Rosa restrains Lucia
nodes.description: Rosa grips Lucia's wrist and holds her until Lucia is seated in the driver's seat with the door shut quietly.
evidence: Rosa reached forward between the seats and pressed Lucia's fist closed more firmly around the barrel of the pen, the way she might have steadied a child's hand at a stove, and held it there

Rosa did not let go of Lucia's fist; she leaned forward until her shoulder pressed against the back of Lucia's seat and said, almost into her ear, "It binds everything," and tipped her chin once toward the line

Rosa caught Lucia's wrist as she reached for the handle, not hard, but with the same steady grip she had once used to walk her up the stairs after the funeral, and she did not let go until Lucia was settled in the driver's seat with the door pulled quietly shut.

nodes.name: briefcase remains secured

evidence: Asha slid into the passenger side, set the briefcase between her feet
as Asha settled the briefcase between her feet on the passenger floor

nodes.name: Asha waits before opening bag
nodes.description: Asha waits until the dome light dims, then opens the bag at her hip and prepares documents.

evidence: laid a notary's seal and three blank affidavits across the dashboard
Asha slid the three blank affidavits across the dashboard until they nudged the curve of the steering wheel

nodes.name: Lucia hesitates before yielding

She did not look at the pages again

her empty hand drifting back into the cardigan pocket where the letter had been

Lucia's hand returned to the empty pocket of her cardigan

nodes.name: Asha insists on acting tonight
nodes.description: Asha says the signing must happen tonight rather than tomorrow, reframing the moment as urgent and decisive.
evidence: "Tonight," Asha said, low, "not tomorrow," and the word landed differently than she had meant it to, less a request than the shape of what the next hour would have to hold.

nodes.name: Asha invites someone to begin

evidence: "Who wants to start?" she asked

nodes.name: Lucia tests the papers
nodes.description: Lucia touches the top affidavit with two fingers, feeling its weight without taking it.
evidence: Lucia drew her hand out of the empty pocket at last and laid two fingers on the top page, not to take it, only to feel the weight of the paper against the vinyl

nodes.name: Lucia questions completeness
nodes.description: Lucia asks whether the affidavits and seal are everything, implying there may be more to the plan.
evidence: "If I sign this," she said, looking at neither of them, "does it bind what I wrote in the letter to the rest of these pages, in front of a court."
"Is this everything," without the lift of a question, as if she already knew the answer would be no and wanted to hear Asha say it anyway.

nodes.name: Rosa presses seal down

nodes.name: Rosa presses seal flat
nodes.description: From the back seat, Rosa leans forward and presses her palm over the notary's seal against the dashboard, holding it there without reacting to Asha.
evidence: From the back seat Rosa leaned forward between them and set her palm flat over the notary's seal, pressing it down against the dashboard the way she had once pressed linens flat on the kitchen table, and she did not lift her hand when Asha looked at her.

nodes.name: Asha states evidence is all they can prove
aliases: Asha states evidence is all they can prove
nodes.description: Asha tells Lucia that the documents represent everything they can prove and slides a pen toward her.
evidence: "It is everything we can prove," Asha said, meeting Lucia's eyes, and slid a pen across the dashboard until it stopped against Lucia's fingertips.

nodes.name: Lucia refuses the pen
nodes.description: Lucia does not take the pen and withdraws her hand into her cardigan pocket, visibly recoiling from the implication of the evidence.
evidence: Lucia did not take it.

She drew her hand slowly off the page and let it fall back into the empty pocket of her cardigan, and her face went the kind of blank that happens when a person has heard exactly what she expected and finds the hearing of it worse than she had braced for.

nodes.name: Rosa urges signing
nodes.description: Rosa pushes the top affidavit toward Lucia and insists that the ink will not dry until they sign.
evidence: From the back seat Rosa lifted her palm from the seal, the embossed disc still warm where she had pressed it, and nudged the topmost affidavit forward across the vinyl until its edge touched Lucia's wrist.

atched out her name in a heavy, uneven hand
